propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py resolves only when scripts/ is on sys.path, causing ModuleNotFoundError when running affected test files as subsets

CI passes because tests/scripts/conftest.py inserts scripts/ on sys.path at collection time, and that process-wide side effect leaks to later-collected modules including tests/unit/, masking the failure
Subset test runs by developers fail but full CI runs pass, training distrust of the test suite and violating the principle that test results must be invocation-independent
Fix requires explicit sys.path.insert of the script's own directory immediately above the sibling import, derived from __file__ to be invocation-independent, idempotent, and non-order-altering

New guard test scripts/import_convention.py must AST-scan scripts/ for bare imports of modules resolvable only via directory inserts, and perform subprocess checks that affected test modules collect when run standalone
